look: Moonstone Ravager, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Moonstone Ravagers family: hulking owl-faced bear with moonstone claws and pale fur. Family anatomy: hulking bear-like predators with owlish facial discs and moonstone claws. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are milky moonstone. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, clear ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
